items.question: What is professional fluoride treatment?
items.answer: Professional fluoride treatment involves applying a concentrated fluoride solution to strengthen tooth enamel, reduce cavity risk, and improve overall oral health.

items.question: Is fluoride treatment safe?
items.answer: Yes. Professional fluoride treatment is safe for both children and adults when performed by qualified dental professionals.

items.question: How long does fluoride treatment take?
items.answer: Most fluoride treatments take only a few minutes and can easily be completed during a routine dental visit.

items.question: How often should I get fluoride treatment?
items.answer: Your dentist may recommend fluoride treatment every 3 to 12 months depending on your cavity risk and oral health needs.

items.question: Can fluoride treatment reduce tooth sensitivity?
items.answer: Yes. Fluoride helps strengthen enamel and can significantly reduce sensitivity caused by exposed dentin or weakened enamel.

items.question: What is the cost of fluoride treatment in Pune?
items.answer: The cost depends on the type of fluoride application and your individual dental needs. A consultation provides an accurate estimate.
